description: A quiet head in pale marble with a cove of light round the ceiling. The walk-in shower is behind frameless glass against black marble, the floor is warm stone, and a slot of frosted glass up high carries the weather. The vanity's mirror is lit from behind. The door seals with a soft magnetic sigh.

window.description: A high slot of frosted glass under the ceiling. It lets the day in and nobody look back.
window.name: the frosted slot
